source_conversation.content: I'm using the YouTube app on my iPhone and the video is in a language I don't understand. Where do I turn on the captions?

sections.text: On iPhone: 1. Go to the watch page of any video. 2. Tap the video player once to show the options, then tap 'Closed captions' to turn captions on. If you don't see the 'Closed captions' button, the video doesn't have captions.

On a computer: 1. Open the video you want to watch. 2. Look for the 'Closed captions' (CC) icon at the bottom right of the video player. It appears only if the video has captions. 3. Click the 'Closed captions' icon to turn captions on.
